description: The chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 outcomes across binned ranges, showing what percentage of observations fall into each Pass@1 interval. The horizontal axis contains the Pass@1 categories as contiguous numeric bins from 0.0 to 1.0 (linear scale), with visible bin edges at approximately 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0; the axis is labeled “Pass@1.” The vertical axis is labeled “Percentage” and uses a linear scale from 0.0 up to about 0.8, with regularly spaced tick marks at roughly 0.1 intervals. There are five light-blue bars corresponding to the bins 0.0–0.2, 0.2–0.4, 0.4–0.6, 0.6–0.8, and 0.8–1.0, each annotated with its percentage: the 0.0–0.2 bin is labeled 11.2%, the 0.2–0.4 bin 3.4%, the 0.4–0.6 bin 3.4%, the 0.6–0.8 bin 5.8%, and the 0.8–1.0 bin 76.2% (the tallest bar, reaching about 0.762 on the y-axis). A red dashed vertical line is drawn near Pass@1 ≈ 0.82 and is annotated in red text as “mean: 0.82.” The bars appear in increasing Pass@1 bin order (left to right), with no additional grouping or stacking, and no special emphasis beyond the percentage labels and the mean reference line.
